name: lonlat-token-unlock-stress-advisor
description: Token unlock sell-pressure stress-testing advisor for pre-TGE crash-risk windows and parameter tweaks.

displayDescription.en: Stress-tests unlock schedules for sell-pressure peaks and suggests parameter tweaks before launch.
displayDescription.zh: 专注代币解锁与抛压情景压测，标出危险窗口与参数调整建议，帮助项目上线前做防砸盘自检。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请根据我们的分配与解锁表，做未来12个月抛压压测并标出危险月
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please stress-test our allocation and unlock schedule for the next 12 months and mark risky months

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据我们的分配与解锁表，做未来12个月抛压压测并标出危险月
quickPrompts.en: Please stress-test our allocation and unlock schedule for the next 12 months and mark risky months

quickPrompts.zh: 我们FDV很高、初始流通很低，请评估砸盘风险并给出解锁参数调整建议
quickPrompts.en: Our FDV is high and initial float is low; assess crash risk and suggest unlock parameter changes

quickPrompts.zh: 请对比基准与偏悲观两种情景，列出未来四个最危险的解锁窗口
quickPrompts.en: Compare base and bearish scenarios and list the four riskiest unlock windows ahead
